content.title: What time does Sabrina Carpenter perform at Coachella 2026? Set time, how to watch
content.text: April 10, 2026, 12:58 p.m. ETSabrina Carpenter will perform on Coachella's main stage Friday, April 10, with her set expected to run from 9:05 to 10:35 p.m. PT. The Coachella headliner will perform at the same time to kick off the festival's second weekend on Friday, April 17.Carpenter is headlining a stacked Friday Coachella lineup that includes The xx, Turnstile, Disclosure, Ethel Cain, Sexxy Red and Devo.How to Watch Sabrina Carpenter at Coachella 2026Coachella is livestreaming most of Friday's sets on YouTube. You can also watch via the Coachella Livestream app, which syncs to your time zone.What will Sabrina Carpenter perform at Coachella 2026?This is Carpenter’s first time headlining Coachella following a wildly successful few years for the Grammy-winning artist. While her set list is under wraps, it's likely to pull heavily from her most recent albums, Short n’ Sweet and Man’s Best Friend, and possibly some of her earlier hits, including "Nonsense" and "Feather."See Coachella's full Friday, April 10, 2026 lineup (all times PT)Coachella StageRecord Safari – 4:15–5:20 p.m.Teddy Swims – 5:30–6:20 p.m.The xx – 7:00–7:55 p.m.Turnstile – 8:05–9:00 p.m.Sabrina Carpenter – 9:05–10:35 p.m.Anyma – 12:00 a.m.Outdoor TheatreTiffany Tyson – 2:50–3:50 p.m.Dabeull – 4:00–4:50 p.m.Lykke Li – 5:20–6:10 p.m.Dijon – 6:40–7:30 p.m.Disclosure – 10:35–11:50 p.m.SonoraDoom Dave – 1:00–1:40 p.m.February – 1:40–2:10 p.m.Carolina Durante – 2:35–3:15 p.m.Wednesday – 3:40–4:20 p.m.Fleshwater – 4:50–5:30 p.m.The Two Lips – 6:00–6:40 p.m.Ninajirachi – 7:10–8:00 p.m.Cachirula & Loojan – 8:25–9:05 p.m.Hot Mulligan – 10:00–10:45 p.m.Not For Radio – 11:50 p.m.–12:50 a.m.GobiCahuilla Bird Singers and Dancers – 2:15–2:45 p.m.Bob Baker Marionettes – 2:55–3:35 p.m.NewDad – 4:00–4:40 p.m.Joyce Manor – 5:10–5:50 p.m.CMAT – 6:15–6:55 p.m.fakemink – 7:20–8:00 p.m.Holly Humberstone – 8:25–9:10 p.m.Joost – 9:50–10:35 p.m.Creepy Nuts – 11:05–11:55 p.m.MojaveNovasoul – 2:00–2:50 p.m.Slayyyter – 3:00–3:45 p.m.BINI – 4:15–5:00 p.m.Central Cee – 5:30–6:15 p.m.Devo – 6:45–7:40 p.m.Moby – 8:10–9:00 p.m.Ethel Cain – 10:35–11:25 p.m.Blood Orange – 11:55 p.m.–12:45 a.m.SaharaMASSIO – 2:30–3:35 p.m.Youna – 3:45–4:35 p.m.HUGEL – 4:50–5:50 p.m.Marlon Hoffstadt – 6:15–7:15 p.m.KATSEYE – 8:00–8:45 p.m.Levity – 9:15–10:20 p.m.Swae Lee – 10:50–11:40 p.m.Sexyy Red – 12:05–12:55 a.m.YumaSahar Z – 1:00–1:45 p.m.Jessica Brankka – 1:45–2:45 p.m.Arodes – 2:45–3:45 p.m.Groove Armada – 3:45–4:45 p.m.Rossi. x Chloé Caillet – 4:45–6:00 p.m.Kettama – 6:00–7:15 p.m.Prospa – 7:15–8:30 p.m.Max Dean x Luke Dean – 8:30–9:45 p.m.Max Styler – 9:45–11:15 p.m.Gordo – 11:15 p.m.–12:55 a.m.QuasarPAWSA – 9:00–11:00 p.m.Tiga – 5:00–7:00 p.m.Deep Dish – 7:00–9:00 p.m.
